name: What is the typical process for double-hung window replacement?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for double-hung window replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: The replacement process typically begins with an initial consultation and measurement, followed by the removal of your old windows. The new double-hung windows are then installed, sealed, and insulated to ensure optimal performance. Finally, we finish the interior and exterior trim. What may affect the timing and complexity is whether your existing window frames are in good condition or require repair or replacement, which can add steps to the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, old window removal, new window installation, sealing, insulation, and trim. Frame condition can affect complexity.
